spec.name: zeb/prosemirror
spec.description: ProseMirror editing engine (view 1.42, model 1.25) under zeb/ui/editor: Zebflow's block schema composed with a caller's extensions, createEditor with callbacks and no UI of its own, unknown nodes kept on load and save, the ProseMirror packages as `pm` for custom editors.

full-1.41.note: All PM packages bundled inline via esbuild. No CDN fetches at runtime. Build: cd /tmp/zeb-pm-build && npm install && node_modules/.bin/esbuild entry.mjs --bundle --format=esm --minify --outfile=prosemirror.bundle.mjs
